targetPackage.name: @mez-systems/design-system-web
targetPackage.productionVersionEligibility: Only after authority reconciliation, CMP-05/CMP-06 disposition, redacted proof review, isolated package proof and named consumer proof pass.

inventoryGranularity: Each entry is one release-copy unit or one explicitly external ownership unit. Runtime references are additionally traced by verify_release_boundary.py.

dependencies.releaseTreatment: Copy the active authority manifest and bounded approval records into an immutable package authority snapshot after ledger reconciliation.
Copy the immutable cutover ledger and its reconciled post-cutover supplement into the package authority snapshot, retaining every cited bounded approval source.
Copy byte-for-byte with fonts, licences, manifests and ordered CSS entrypoint.
Use its verified identity data, renderer, palettes and assets as assembly inputs; do not nest or relabel the migration snapshot as production-ready.
Copy into package identity data with its source hash and schema.
Generate the package catalogue, runtime palettes and exact static twins from canonical source authority; retain integrity and provenance.
Copy the approved shared renderer with local palette data and no canonical-checkout import.
Copy the exact two-path asset once and reference the package-local URL.

Package approved disc, sphere, Wings/mark, Product Card, Trading Card, Website Motion and Expression Stress contracts with their schemas, validators, guidance and examples; retain each scope boundary.
Consume the deterministic component release rather than the workbench-relative source import.
Copy the approved Round 28 source, schema, review, approval, composition and accessibility contracts without claiming consumer routes or deployment authority.
Copy only the approved page-local HTML, CSS and JavaScript after rebasing every import to package entrypoints; exclude review controls, labs and raw evidence media.
Copy only the sixteen referenced mark assets plus attribution/provenance if legal review permits; never copy the full research registry by default or treat marks as Mez identity data.

Copy only the canonical 1.0.0 code, schema, guidance, approval and verifier. Media preparation, fixture likenesses and consumer content remain outside the component package unless separately reviewed.

Copy the canonical 1.0.0 component machinery, schema, guidance, approval and verifier. Keep the seven-person fixture as dated example content and require consumer-owned media and consent provenance for deployment.
Ship only as a clearly dated example unless the named consumer supplies and owns a production content payload with freshness and consent metadata.
Do not include by default. The consumer supplies approved public derivatives and consent provenance through the testimonial content interface.
Never copy raw PNG bytes. Accept only derivatives that validate against operating-proof-payload.schema.json and carry public-release approval.
Include concise approval and test receipts in guidance; exclude rejected labs, feedback controls and historical workbench rounds from runtime.
The package dispatches documented destination events and accepts content/configuration; the consumer owns URLs, analytics, SEO deployment and live availability.
Do not hardcode as design-system authority. The named consumer supplies the destination or omits it.

candidateResolution.policy: No candidate enters a production package without its own closed gate and distinct decision ID.

exclusionInterface.inputContract: Source-ordered testimonials with quote, name, handle, follower snapshot metadata, verified state, optional approved portrait and consent/provenance reference.
exclusionInterface.staticAdapter: A complete semantic ordered list is required when CMP-05 or CMP-06 is unavailable, under reduced motion and in media failure.
exclusionInterface.parityRule: If the candidate components are excluded, the package may not claim exact Golden Homepage visual parity until a bounded homepage adaptation is reviewed.

requirements: Preserve original SHA-256 and semantic role without preserving an absolute source path.
Create a separate derivative; never overwrite the evidence original.
Record redaction methods, derivative SHA-256, alt text, reviewer and review timestamp.
Verify that names, personal data, customer data, secrets, tokens, URLs, workspace identifiers and unrelated private content are absent or deliberately approved.
Set publicReleaseEligible true only after human visual inspection of the exact derivative bytes.

cleanConsumerProof.method: Copy only the assembled package into a temporary directory, make the canonical checkout inaccessible to the test process, install no network dependency, serve the included example, and run the included verifier from that copy.
requiredChecks: all package manifests and SHA-256 hashes agree after a deterministic rebuild
all CSS, JavaScript, fonts, licences, JSON, static twins, SVGs and approved media resolve package-locally
zero runtime HTTP or HTTPS design dependency and zero canonical-checkout path
keyboard order, visible focus, screen-reader landmarks and names, reduced motion, no-WebGL and missing-media states preserve complete meaning
no document overflow at declared viewports and no content hidden behind swipe-only access
the rendered footer or diagnostic endpoint exposes package name, version and manifest hash

versioning.visibility: Expose package name, semantic version and manifest hash through package metadata, a runtime read-only version export and a visible diagnostic/footer hook controlled by the consumer.
versioning.update: Install the next immutable package version, run its verifier and consumer smoke suite, compare the recorded previous and next manifest hashes, then switch the consumer lockfile reference.
versioning.rollback: Retain the last known-good immutable package and consumer lockfile. Restore that exact version and manifest hash without reverting consumer-owned content or copying canonical source files.
versioning.compatibility: Breaking public entrypoint, event, content or slot changes require a major version. Candidate-component promotion may not mutate an already published package version.

consumerInterface.name: Mez Systems production web
packageOwns: identity assets and Living Core runtime
Golden Homepage composition and responsive behaviour
consumerOwns: testimonial wording, follower freshness and likeness consent operations
application, commerce, authentication and payment logic

authorityReconciliation.rule: PORT-02 preserved the hash-locked 2026-07-21 cutover ledger, retained the three existing Olli approval records and added two separately approved component promotions to the post-cutover supplement.

followUps.exit: Separate promotion or exclusion decisions exist for CMP-05 and CMP-06, follower policy is resolved, and decision authority is reconciled.
A deterministic self-contained release candidate and redacted proof payload pass isolated verification.
The registered consumer proves install, version visibility, update and rollback without copied design values.
